protocol: Real native Audio24s PCM; same26 coarse starts every500ms and valid350ms fine +150ms gap; play/pause/resume/seek/rate/offset; no short stops. Synthetic timings do not establish natural model accuracy.
percentileMethod: Nearest-rank sorted finite samples at ceil(p*n)-1, p50/p95 retained. medianArithmetic is standard average of two central values for even n.
sampling: Traces/functional are separate from untraced full interleaved A/B cold5 each and warm3 each. Cold means fresh owned Electron/profile/document; OS cache is not globally cleared. Warm means same Electron/document/source first played through1.2s before resetting observations.

matrix.classification: Untraced repeated same-protocol real-media comparison; trace diagnostics are excluded; original per-run distributions and maxima are retained
matrix.coldDefinition: Fresh Electron process, isolated unique profile and newly loaded Output document; OS/font/disk cache is not globally cleared.
matrix.warmDefinition: Same Electron/Output document first plays the identical source until 1.2s to prime fonts and line-fit, then pauses/seeks0 and clears only observation arrays before the original full playback protocol. Offset content change can legitimately remeasure.
matrix.signConvention: Positive late, negative early; media milliseconds and rate-adjusted wall milliseconds are reported separately
limitations: Five cold and three warm full runs per variant are interleaved A/B; this remains a bounded diagnostic sample, not a population-wide guarantee.
No hardware audio output, OBS, original lyrics/model accuracy or arbitrary-template claim.
Known onsets, PCM definition and control sequence are unchanged; frame/sample counts and control phase endpoints vary naturally.
Seek-discontinuity cross-window interpolation can produce ambiguous control-boundary signed values; these remain in original control windows and are separate from steady onset distributions.

firstActivations.classification: Supplemental initial-activation versus repeated-activation classification. Legacy all-transition distributions and maxima are retained unchanged in summary/matrix.
firstActivations.rule: Mark seen by phase + known chunk startMs from every raw sample, including transitions inside 350ms control exclusion; only then apply identical steady filter. Replay after seek has distinct phase. Prior active carry-over at phase start also marks seen.

limitations: Screenshots were captured over recorded native media brackets, not at one perfectly synchronized instant.
Mid samples pair to the nearest genuine local Audio sample; they are functional evidence, separate from performance latency.

results.classification: Real first observed local activation; rate phase at offset0, not an offset pairing or reentry. The preceding local observation gap is part of the result. No trace was active, so long task/GC/OS/rAF scheduling cause is unknown.
